note: Atlas is 1024x1024 native; world coords = atlas px x 6. Overlay x,y is the sprite TOP-LEFT in world coords (matches shipped overlay_yeti2 at world 2940,1944 = atlas 490,324). Prop x,y is the ANCHOR position in world coords, with anchorX/anchorY the sprite-local anchor (matches shipped prop_black_gable). Every sprite is fully opaque-or-transparent (no partial alpha) and free of reserved teal #58D6C0 +-10.

assets.name: overlay_redwyrm
assets.placement: Volcano north shoulder, silhouetted against the ice shelf and teal water. MOVED from the shipped 736,306: at that spawn a red dragon on red volcanic rock is invisible (verified on the placement composite).

assets.name: overlay_redwyrm_breath
assets.placement: Over open sea east of the volcano cliff, so the plume reads against blue water. Frames 0-2 are a hard-edged orange-white cone, 3-5 the plume balloons, 6-7 it collapses to dark smoke. Source frame 8 was DROPPED: the dragon itself vanishes from it.

assets.name: overlay_stormdrake
assets.supersedes: env/overlay_stormdrake (was 72x32, 9f, bat-winged palette swap of the red)
assets.placement: Frostmere circuit, over the ice shelf. New anatomy: long serpentine body, four feathered fin-wings, spined crest, slate blue-grey with a pale belly. Shifted 30px west of ART-03's 380,190 to clear the ice tower at atlas 452.

assets.name: overlay_stormdrake_breath
assets.placement: The storm-coast play near the Storm House, in the slot the old stormdrake vacates when its primary path moves north. Forked white-core arc fires on frames 0-1, then the serpent flies on - use playLoops 1 so the strike reads as the entrance event.

assets.name: prop_ice_tower
assets.placement: N2 crag on the ice shelf, north of and above the Glasslake. Original crystalline ice-mage tower: dark stone core with faceted ice spires and a pale blue summit beacon. The dark core is what makes it read against snow.

assets.name: overlay_ice_beacon
assets.placement: Drawn at exactly the prop_ice_tower rect. overlay_ice_beacon_f0.png is BYTE-IDENTICAL to prop_ice_tower.png, so the tower never blinks: between plays the static prop shows, during a play the ice shimmers and the summit beacon pulses. Costs one prop slot plus one overlay slot; the one-slot alternative is a single continuous overlay, but atlas x 452 sits inside the J-3 restricted band x276-706, so the interval form is the safe default.

assets.name: prop_fairy_castle
assets.placement: Whispering Woods glade NNW of the WW marker (383,509); clear of all three WW routes and of Haven's Rest. Carries its own painted glade ring, stream, mushrooms and lit windows. NOTE: 96 wide, not ART-03's 64 - the wider sprite was accepted on the atlas composite because the tree canopy inside it matches the forest canopy scale; at 64 it would have to be re-authored.

assets.name: overlay_fairy_motes
assets.placement: Beside the castle, east edge of the glade. Warm honey-gold motes with a faint pale-green halo - not cyan, not UI squares, no faces, no figures. Interval form because atlas x 378 is inside the J-3 band. FRAME SELECTION: the 8-frame animate pass kept turning the motes into dark insect shapes on alternate frames; the shipped 4 frames are source frames 0,1,5,6 - the ones that stay lit. Deterministic selection only, no pixels altered.

assets.name: prop_storm_house
assets.placement: SW Gloaming knoll - the map's darkest pocket. Lone dark timber house, three lit amber windows, bent dead trees, a churning black cloud pocket over the roof. NOTE: ART-03 6 quotes world anchor (1140,5148), which is the rect's TOP-LEFT, not an anchor; under the shipped prop convention (prop_black_gable) the anchor for that same rect is (1308,5526). Integrator: confirm which the brief meant.

assets.name: overlay_storm_lightning
assets.placement: Over the storm house's cloud pocket. A forked branching bolt, NOT a full-box flash: frames 0-1 bright white fork with side branches, 2-4 dimming to violet, 5 nearly gone, 6-7 empty (155 opaque px of 2478). Most of the play is dark, so it reads as an occasional strike.

assets.name: overlay_deer2
assets.placement: W1 taper, woods EDGE not interior. Doe grazing with head down plus a standing fawn; the doe lifts and lowers her head, the fawn shifts and turns. No ground platform - the animals stand on painted terrain.

assets.name: overlay_bear3
assets.placement: Longwood interior, south of the shipped overlay_bear2 (atlas 340,592). Full four-legged amble cycle.

assets.name: overlay_yeti3
assets.placement: New snow country, well clear of the shipped overlay_yeti2 (atlas 490,324). Bipedal shaggy snow ape striding; the animate pass cleaned off the still's loose snow spray.

assets.name: overlay_wolfpair
assets.placement: Wolfwood, in place. Two clearly separated slate-grey wolves; the near one paces and lowers its head, the far one scans. Third attempt - the first two came back as a blob on a hard isometric dirt diamond.

assets.name: overlay_wagon
assets.placement: HR-to-Whispering-Woods road. Covered wagon with a cream tilt and two harnessed oxen, facing west - travel is negative x to match. Still only: travel is the overlay's job, per brief.

assets.name: overlay_crows
assets.placement: Forgotten Hollow, over the standing stones. Verified legible on the atlas composite - dark bird marks read against the green, which is why they go here and not over dark forest.

assets.name: overlay_snowdrift
assets.placement: NW snow country. Powder curl lifts, scatters and settles to almost nothing by the last frame (1107 -> 486 opaque px).

assets.name: overlay_lantern
assets.placement: Haven's Rest settlement life. Continuous is acceptable at this size, but atlas x 450 is inside the J-3 band - integrator may prefer playLoops 4 / intervalMillis 9000. Canvas is 16x16, not the requested 12x12: PixelLab rejects any side below 16.

assets.name: overlay_chimney_smoke2
assets.placement: Haven's Rest rooftop. WARNING: this sprite includes a small chimney pot at its base, so it must sit ON a roofline, never on open ground.

assets.name: overlay_fishing_boat
assets.placement: Open water east of the lighthouse headland - MOVED from 700,640, which put the hull on land. Rocks on the swell with a shifting waterline ripple.
